name: Death Mark
tooltip:
Death Mark
25 Energy / 1 to 5 Combo Points20 yd range
Instant10 sec cooldown
Requires Rogue
Requires level 60
Finishing move that marks the target, storing a portion of the damage dealt by your attacks per Combo Point. Garrote and Rupture damage is stored at twice the rate. After 6 sec, the stored damage is dealt, up to a maximum increased by Attack Power and Critical Strike chance:
  1 point  : 12% stored, [((156 + 245 + 0.04 * Attack Power) * ($mcrit / 100 + 1)) * 1] damage cap
  2 points: 24% stored, [((156 + (490) + 2 * 0.04 * Attack Power) * ($mcrit / 100 + 1)) * 1] damage cap
  3 points: 36% stored, [((156 + (735) + 3 * 0.04 * Attack Power) * ($mcrit / 100 + 1)) * 1] damage cap
  4 points: 48% stored, [((156 + (980) + 4 * 0.04 * Attack Power) * ($mcrit / 100 + 1)) * 1] damage cap
  5 points: 60% stored, [((156 + (1225) + 5 * 0.04 * Attack Power) * ($mcrit / 100 + 1)) * 1] damage cap
